question: The first National Winter Games were hosted by _________ .
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Gulmarg**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gulmarg** is located in the **Baramulla district** of **Jammu and Kashmir**, India.
 
• It is a well-known **hill station** and a popular destination for **skiing and winter sports**.
 
• The **first National Winter Games of India** were held in **1998** in Gulmarg, marking a significant milestone in the promotion of winter sports in the country.
 
• Gulmarg is renowned for its **natural beauty** and is often referred to as the "**Meadow of Flowers**."
 
• The region is home to the **Gulmarg Gondola**, one of the **world’s highest cable cars**, which serves as a major attraction for tourists and winter sports enthusiasts.
 
• Its **geographical features**, including snow-covered slopes, make it an ideal location for hosting winter sports events.
 
• The initiative to host the National Winter Games in Gulmarg played a key role in boosting tourism and enhancing India's presence in international winter sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Manali**__

 __
 
• **Manali** is a famous hill station in **Himachal Pradesh**, India.
 
• It is known for its **adventure sports** such as paragliding, river rafting, and trekking.
 
• Manali is not associated with hosting the **National Winter Games**, but it remains a popular destination for winter tourists.
 
 
 
• **Srinagar**__
 __
 
• **Srinagar** is the **summer capital** of **Jammu and Kashmir**.
 
• It is famous for its **Dal Lake, houseboats, and Mughal gardens**.
 
• While Srinagar is a prime tourist destination, it has not hosted the **National Winter Games**.
 
 
 
• **Auli**__
 
 
• **Auli** is a **ski destination** in the Indian state of **Uttarakhand**.
 
• It is known for its **snow-covered slopes** and is considered one of the best skiing destinations in India.
 
• Although Auli hosts several skiing events, it did not host the **first National Winter Games**.
